author: nickyeow

english.text: Though I failed, I will try again.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 sat1 baai6 zo2，daan6 hai6 ngo5 wui5 si3 do1 jat1 ci3 ge3。
text: 雖然我失敗咗，但係我會試多一次嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: In case of fire, do not use the lift.

jyutping: fo2 zuk1 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 daap3 lip1。
text: 火燭嗰陣唔好搭𨋢。

author: nickyeow

author: nickyeow

english.text: I never have an ice cream without feeling happy.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 sik6 syut3 gou1 zau6 wui5 gok3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1。
text: 我一食雪糕就會覺得好開心。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What is the emergency telephone number?

jyutping: gan2 gap1 lyun4 lok3 din6 waa2 gei2 do1 hou6 aa3？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He said, "My car is always breaking down."

jyutping: keoi5 waa6：「ngo5 gaa3 ce1 seng4 jat6 dou1 sei2 fo2。」
text: 佢話：「我架車成日都死火。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't like walking home alone after dark.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 tin1 hak1 zi1 hau6 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei2。
text: 我唔鍾意天黑之後一個人行返屋企。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He takes after his father.

jyutping: keoi5 tung4 keoi5 aa3 baa4 hou2 ci5 joeng2。
text: 佢同佢阿爸好似樣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll eat my hat if she turns up on time.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 zeon2 si4 lai4 dou3，ngo5 zau6 cit3 go3 tau2 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong1 dang3 co5。
text: 如果佢準時嚟到，我就切個頭落嚟俾你當凳坐。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We are men.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai6 naam4 jan4。
text: 我哋係男人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What happened to you?

jyutping: gaau2 me1 aa3 nei5？
text: 搞咩呀你？

author: fercheung

english.text: Christopher Columbus wasn't an explorer because he loved the sea. He was an explorer because he hated Spanish jails.

jyutping: go1 leon4 bou3 zi1 so2 ji5 sing4 wai4 taam3 him2 gaa1，bing6 m4 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 jit6 oi3 daai6 hoi2，ji4 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 zang1 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 ge3 gaam1 juk6。
text: 哥倫布之所以成為探險家，並唔係因為佢熱愛大海，而係因為佢憎西班牙嘅監獄。

author: fercheung

english.text: Do not read while walking.

jyutping: m4 hou2 jat1 bin1 haang4 lou6 jat1 bin1 tai2 syu1。
text: 唔好一邊行路一邊睇書。

english.text: The bird is in the sky.

jyutping: zek3 zoek3 hai2 go3 tin1 hung1 dou6。

author: kaenif

english.text: I think you panicked.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 nei5 geng1 zo2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you think we'll have a white Christmas this year?
Do you think that we'll have a white Christmas this year?

jyutping: nei5 waa6 gam1 nin4 sing3 daan3 wui5 m4 wui5 lok6 syut3 aa1 naa4？
text: 你話今年聖誕會唔會落雪吖嗱？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let me take a nap.

jyutping: dang2 ngo5 hap6 jat1 zan6 sin1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why aren't you sleepy?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 nei5 m4 ngaan5 fan3 ge3？
text: 點解你唔眼瞓嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: That's, like, just your opinion, man.

jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 ze1，ngo5 m4 gok3 wo3。
text: 你覺得啫，我唔覺喎。

author: Akh2403

english.text: What the hell are you doing?

jyutping: nei5 gaau2 mat1 gwai2 aa3？

english.text: What's the matter now?

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 jau6 dim2 aa2？

english.text: You shouldn't study all day long. You should go out and have some fun.

jyutping: nei5 bat1 jing1 goi1 seng4 jat6 dou1 duk6 syu1，jing1 goi1 ceot1 heoi3 waan2 haa5 sin1 ngaam1。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: How much do you know about this city?

jyutping: nei5 deoi3 ni1 go3 sing4 si5 jau5 ge3 jing6 sik1 jau5 gei2 do1 ne1？

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Anna Wilkinson is a researcher at the University of Lincoln. She explained that a tortoise's neck length is a sign of whether the tortoise is comfortable in its surroundings. The longer the neck, the more at ease the animal is.

jyutping: Anna Wilkinson hai6 lam4 hang2 daai6 hok6 ge3 jin4 gau3 jyun4，keoi5 gaai2 sik1 waa6 gwai1 ge3 geng2 coeng4 hai6 gwai1 hai2 keoi5 zau1 wai4 ge3 waan4 ging2 hai6 mai6 syu1 fuk6 ge3 zik1 zoeng6。geng2 bou6 jyut6 coeng4，dung6 mat6 zau6 jyut6 sung1 di1。
text: Anna Wilkinson 係林肯大學嘅研究員，佢解釋話龜嘅頸長係龜喺佢周圍嘅環境係咪舒服嘅跡象。頸部越長，動物就越鬆啲。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: We are fortunate to be living in the most peaceful, most prosperous, most progressive era in human history. That may surprise young people who are watching TV or looking at your phones and it seems like only bad news comes through every day. But consider that it’s been decades since the last war between major powers. More people live in democracies. We’re wealthier and healthier and better educated, with a global economy that has lifted up more than a billion people from extreme poverty, and created new middle classes from the Americas to Africa to Asia.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hou2 coi2 sang1 wut6 hai2 jan4 leoi6 lik6 si2 soeng6 zeoi3 wo4 ping4、zeoi3 faan4 wing4、zeoi3 zeon3 bou6 ge3 si4 doi6，ni1 go3 ho2 nang4 wui5 ling6 tai2 gan2 din6 si6 waak6 ze2 tai2 gan2 sau2 gei1 ge3 nin4 hing1 jan4 gam2 dou3 ging1 ngaa5，ji4 ce2 ci5 fu4 mui5 jat6 dou1 zi2 jau5 waai6 siu1 sik1，daan6 hai6 haau2 leoi6 haa6，zi6 cung4 soeng6 ci3 daai6 gwok3 zi1 gaan1 faat3 sang1 zin3 zang1 zi1 hau6，ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4。ngo5 dei6 gang3 fu3 jyu6、gang3 gin6 hong1、sau6 gwo3 gang3 hou2 ge3 gaau3 juk6，cyun4 kau4 ging1 zai3 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 ciu1 gwo3 10 jik1 jan4 cung4 gik6 dou6 pan4 kung4 zung1 laai1 ceot1 lai4，jik6 cong3 zou6 zo2 jau4 mei5 zau1 dou3 fei1 zau1 zoi3 dou3 aa3 zau1 ge3 san1 zung1 caan2 gaai1 kap1。
text: 我哋好彩生活喺人類歷史上最和平、最繁榮、最進步嘅時代，呢個可能會令睇緊電視或者睇緊手機嘅年輕人感到驚訝，而且似乎每日都只有壞消息，但係考慮下，自從上次大國之間發生戰爭之後，已經過咗幾十年。我哋更富裕、更健康、受過更好嘅教育，全球經濟已經將超過 10 億人從極度貧窮中拉出嚟，亦創造咗由美洲到非洲再到亞洲嘅新中產階級。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The little wars are not escalating to a Great War. Is there Intervention of some sort, maybe? Is the dystopic post-apocalyptic scenario with few human survivors becoming an "old man's dream," along with technological retrogression? What other scenarios are possible? I know that some multibillionaires are "horrified" that humanity may be replaced by intelligent machinery. Alternatively, there may be sneaky people who think that humanity should be replaced as soon as possible, maybe.

jyutping: siu2 zin3 zang1 m4 hai6 sing1 kap1 dou3 daai6 zin3。jau5 mou5 mau5 zung2 gon1 jyu6 cou3 si1，ho2 nang4 hai6？jan4 leoi6 hang6 cyun4 ze2 hou2 siu2 ge3 bei1 kek6 hau6 mut6 jat6 coeng4 ging2，hai6 mai6 tung4 fo1 gei6 teoi3 faa3 jat1 cai4 sing4 wai4「lou5 jan4 gaa1 ge3 mung6 soeng2」？zung6 jau5 di1 me1 cing4 fong3 hai6 ho2 nang4 ge3？ngo5 zi1 dou3 jau5 di1 jik1 maan6 fu3 jung1「hou2 geng1」jan4 leoi6 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei6 zi3 nang4 gei1 haai6 ceoi2 doi6。waak6 ze2，ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 di1 gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6 ge3 jan4 gok3 dak1 jan4 leoi6 jing1 goi1 zeon6 faai3 bei6 ceoi2 doi6，ho2 nang4 wui5。
text: 小戰爭唔係升級到大戰。有冇某種干預措施，可能係？人類幸存者好少嘅悲劇後末日場景，係咪同科技退化一齊成為「老人家嘅夢想」？仲有啲咩情況係可能嘅？我知道有啲億萬富翁「好驚」人類可能會被智能機械取代。或者，可能會有啲鬼鬼祟祟嘅人覺得人類應該盡快被取代，可能會。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's a warm blue-sky 23rd of July of 2025, here on Lulu Island. In the morning, I walked to Tim Hortons café to get iced coffee with oat milk. I then walked to sunny South Arm Park to enjoy it amidst the magical forest there. Drinking, I sat at wooden picnic tables. It was like a dream! Incidentally, I'm a café hobbyist, I recognize now. On the web, on my Social Media, I view impressive pictures of cafés throughout Japan.

jyutping: 2025 nin4 7 jyut6 23 hou6，hai6 jat1 go3 wan1 nyun5 ge3 laam4 tin1，nei1 dou6 hai6 lou6 lou6 dou2。ziu1 zou2，ngo5 haang4 heoi3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1 lo2 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 bing1 gaa3 fe1。zi1 hau6 ngo5 zau6 haang4 heoi3 joeng4 gwong1 pou2 ziu3 ge3 naam4 bei3 gung1 jyun2，hai2 go2 dou6 ge3 san4 kei4 sam1 lam4 zung1 hoeng2 sau6 haa2。jam2 gan2 je5，ngo5 zo6 hai2 muk6 zai3 je5 caan1 toi2 dou6。hou2 ci5 faat3 zo2 go3 mung6 gam2！seon6 daai3 jat1 tai4，ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 gaa3 fe1 teng1 oi3 hou3 ze2，ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jing6 dak1。hai2 mong5 lok6 soeng6 min6，hai2 ngo5 ge3 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6 min6，ngo5 wui5 tai2 dou3 jat6 bun2 gok3 dei6 ge3 gaa3 fe1 gun2 ge3 ling6 jan4 jan3 zoeng6 sam1 haak1 ge3 soeng1。
text: 2025年7月23號，係一個溫暖嘅藍天，呢度係露露島。朝早，我行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳攞燕麥奶嘅冰咖啡。之後我就行去陽光普照嘅南臂公園，喺嗰度嘅神奇森林中享受吓。飲緊嘢，我坐喺木製野餐枱度。好似發咗個夢噉！順帶一提，我係一個咖啡廳愛好者，我而家認得。喺網絡上面，喺我嘅社交媒體上面，我會睇到日本各地嘅咖啡館嘅令人印象深刻嘅相。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In high school, my gang included the mulatto Jamaican Graeme, the intellectual Russian-Scot Kenneth, the Hokkien-speaking Chinese-Filipino Philip, and myself. We often ate lunch together. We played video games and computer games. Our favourite board game was Risk, whose objective was land conquest. Graeme lived in a townhouse complex with a nice swimming pool, in which we swam.

jyutping: hai2 gou1 zung1 go2 zan6，ngo5 ge3 bong1 paai3 baau1 kut3 hak1 baak6 wan6 hyut3 ji4 ngaa4 maai5 gaa1 jan4 gaak3 leoi4 mou5、zi1 sik1 fan6 zi2 ngo4 lo4 si1 sou1 gaak3 laan4 jan4 hang2 nei4 si1、gong2 fuk1 gin3 waa2 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 fuk1 gin3 jan4 fei2 lei6 pou2，tung4 maai4 ngo5 zi6 gei2。ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 ng5 caan1。ngo5 dei6 waan2 zo2 din6 zi2 jau4 hei3 tung4 din6 nou5 jau4 hei3。ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 coek3 soeng6 jau4 hei3 hai6 Risk ，keoi5 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 zing1 fuk6 tou2 dei6。 Graeme zyu6 hai2 jat1 go3 jau5 gaan1 hou2 leng3 ge3 wing6 ci4 ge3 lyun4 paai4 bit6 seoi6 daai6 haa6，ngo5 dei6 hai2 go2 dou6 jau4 seoi2。
text: 喺高中嗰陣，我嘅幫派包括黑白混血兒牙買加人格雷姆、知識分子俄羅斯蘇格蘭人肯尼斯、講福建話嘅菲律賓福建人菲利普，同埋我自己。我哋成日一齊食午餐。我哋玩咗電子遊戲同電腦遊戲。我哋最鍾意嘅桌上遊戲係Risk ，佢嘅目標係征服土地。 Graeme 住喺一個有間好靚嘅泳池嘅聯排別墅大廈，我哋喺嗰度游水。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The Lord also said to Moses: Say to Aaron, Take thy rod; and stretch forth thy hand upon the waters of Egypt, and upon their rivers, and streams and pools, and all the ponds of waters, that they may be turned into blood: and let blood be in all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and of stone.

jyutping: zyu2 jik6 deoi3 mo1 sai1 gong2：nei5 deoi3 aa3 leon4 gong2：lo2 nei5 ge3 zoeng6；nei5 jiu3 zoeng1 nei5 ge3 sau2 san1 hai2 oi1 kap6 ge3 seoi2、keoi5 dei6 ge3 ho4 lau4、kai1 lau4、seoi2 ci4，tung4 maai4 so2 jau5 ge3 seoi2 ci4 soeng6 min6，dang2 keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bin3 sing4 hyut3。oi1 kap6 cyun4 dei6，mou4 leon6 hai6 muk6 hei3 ding6 hai6 sek6 hei3，dou1 jiu3 jau5 hyut3。
text: 主亦對摩西講：你對亞倫講：攞你嘅杖；你要將你嘅手伸喺埃及嘅水、佢哋嘅河流、溪流、水池，同埋所有嘅水池上面，等佢哋可以變成血。埃及全地，無論係木器定係石器，都要有血。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: When thus the prophet Helenus I hail, / "Troy-born interpreter of Heaven! whose art / the signs of Phoebus' pleasure can impart; / thou know'st the tripod and the Clarian bay, / the stars, the voices of the birds, that dart / on wings with omens laden, speak and say, / (since fate and all the gods foretell a prosperous way / and point to far Italia)."

jyutping: dong1 ngo5 fun1 jing4 sin1 zi1 hoi2 leon4 nou5 si1， / 「dak6 lok6 ji1 ceot1 sang1 ge3 tin1 tong4 gaai2 sik1 ze2！keoi5 ge3 ngai6 seot6 / fei1 bei2 si1 ge3 lok6 ceoi3 zik1 zoeng6 ho2 ji5 cyun4 dai6； / nei5 zi1 dou3 saam1 goek3 gaa2 tung4 hak1 laai1 lei5 on1 waan1， / sing1 sing1，zoek3 niu5 ge3 sing1 jam1，go2 zi1 fei1 biu1 / hai2 jik6 soeng6 daai3 zyu6 jyu6 siu6，gong2 je5， / （jan1 wai6 ming6 wan6 tung4 so2 jau5 ge3 dou6 lou6 / san4 dou1 jyu6 si6 zyu6 jat1 go3 faan4 wing4 ge3 fong1 hoeng3）。」
text: 當我歡迎先知海倫努斯， / 「特洛伊出生嘅天堂解釋者！佢嘅藝術 / 菲比斯嘅樂趣跡象可以傳遞； / 你知道三腳架同克拉里安灣， / 星星，雀鳥嘅聲音，嗰支飛鏢 / 喺翼上帶住預兆，講嘢， / （因為命運同所有嘅道路 / 神都預示住一個繁榮嘅方向）。」
